Authors: Peter J. Chen; Jeffrey A. Hussmann; Jun Yan; Friederike Knipping; Purnima Ravisankar; Pin-Fang Chen; Cidi Chen; James W. Nelson; Gregory A. Newby; Mustafa Sahin; Mark J. Osborn; Jonathan S. Weissman; Britt Adamson; David R. Liu
Title: Enhanced prime editing systems by manipulating cellular determinants of editing outcomes
DNA extraction or genotyping method: gDNA lysis buffer followed by two-round Illumina amplicon sequencing and CRISPResso2 analysis
Main improvement claim: PE4/PE5 with MLH1dn and PEmax/epegRNAs substantially improve prime editing efficiency and outcome purity across 191 edits in seven mammalian cell types.

Authors: Fatwa Adikusuma; Caleb Lushington; Jayshen Arudkumar; Gelshan I. Godahewa; Yu C. J. Chey; Luke Gierus; Sandra Piltz; Ashleigh Geiger; Yatish Jain; Daniel Reti; Laurence O.W. Wilson; Denis C. Bauer; Paul Q. Thomas
Title: Optimized nickase- and nuclease-based prime editing in human and mouse cells
DNA extraction or genotyping method: Roche High Pure PCR Template Preparation Kit; Nextera-tagged amplicon sequencing or Sanger sequencing with ICE/DECODR
Main improvement claim: All-in-one PEA1 improves PE3 efficiency, and PE-nuclease enables efficient mouse generation with up to 100% correct edits.

Authors: Seonghyun Lee; Hyunji Lee; Gayoung Baek; Jin-Soo Kim
Title: Precision mitochondrial DNA editing with high-fidelity DddA-derived base editors
DNA extraction or genotyping method: DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit genomic DNA extraction; nested PCR and MiniSeq/whole-mtDNA sequencing analyzed with CRISPR RGEN Tools
Main improvement claim: Interface-engineered HiFi-DdCBEs retain efficient mitochondrial C-to-T editing while avoiding collateral mtDNA off-target mutations.

Authors: Alexis C. Komor; Kevin T. Zhao; Michael S. Packer; Nicole M. Gaudelli; Amanda L. Waterbury; Luke W. Koblan; Y. Bill Kim; Ahmed H. Badran; David R. Liu
Title: Improved base excision repair inhibition and bacteriophage Mu Gam protein yields C:G-to-T:A base editors with higher efficiency and product purity
DNA extraction or genotyping method: Proteinase K/SDS lysis buffer followed by PCR and Illumina MiSeq high-throughput sequencing
Main improvement claim: BE4 increases C:G-to-T:A editing efficiency and product purity, and Mu Gam fusion reduces indel formation during base editing.

Authors: Matthew G. Durrant; Nicholas T. Perry; James J. Pai; Aditya R. Jangid; Januka S. Athukoralage; Masahiro Hiraizumi; John P. McSpedon; April Pawluk; Hiroshi Nishimasu; Silvana Konermann; Patrick D. Hsu
Title: Bridge RNAs direct modular and programmable recombination of target and donor DNA
DNA extraction or genotyping method: GFP recombination reporter quantified by flow cytometry and confirmed by nanopore sequencing
Main improvement claim: Bridge RNA target- and donor-binding loops can be reprogrammed to direct programmable DNA insertion, excision, and inversion.
